a: A zero-height or zero-width box is put on the earliest page it touches, not the one it overlaps most
`createPageRun` on a scene that already has a page run makes a second run that every reader ignores
core's `adoptLegacyPages` reads an unchecked `core:pages` value, so a bad save throws a `TypeError` or lays pages out at NaN
b: pageOfBounds ranks pages by overlap area, so a zero-thickness box goes to the earliest page it touches, not the one it mostly lies on
createPageRun on a scene that already has a page run adds a second run that every page reader ignores
adoptLegacyPages throws a TypeError on a `core:pages` value that is not a PagesDoc
layoutPages looks `align` up in a plain object literal, so an unknown or prototype-named value gives NaN poses
